title: Dunning
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:15 AM

Dunning

You can create payment reminders or dunning letters and send them to your business partners, to alert them of overdue payables
and to request payment.

You can print correspondence either using the Correspondence component or directly by using the application forms that you
have defined in the Print Workbench.

In addition to the features of the standard delivery, you can realize industry-specific dunning activities.

1 Note
Industry Component Utilities (IS-U)

You can dun budget billing requests as well as open items. The dunning run can create lock documents automatically (see
Disconnection/Reconnection of a Utility Installation). You can postprocess the dunning-relevant data manually in the dunning
proposal.

Industry Component Telecommunications (IS-T)

You can postprocess the dunning-relevant data manually in the dunning proposal. If receivables have reached a specific
collection step, you can lock the contract account or the service for a business partner automatically in the dunning activities
run (see Lock Services Using SAP RM-CA and SAP CRM).

Industry Component Insurance (FS-CD)

The following dunning procedure types are supported:

e Individual Dunning Notices

In an individual dunning notice, all items in a contract are considered independently of one another. This means that you
can have several dunning procedures for one contract.

e Collective Dunning
In acollective dunning notice, all items in a contract are dunned with one dunning procedure.
e Multi-Collective dunning

Multiple collective dunning can, in contrast to collective dunning, contain several collective dunning notices for one
business partner/insurance object relationship in parallel.

e Contract Dunning

In a contract dunning notice, only one current dunning procedure exists at any one point in time. This refers to the
oldest item.

e Account Dunning All items due for dunning for a contract account are dunned on a cross-contract basis for account
dunning.

The dunning procedures to be used are determined in the dunning proposal run and saved in the item.
